scope: Motor-free sensor diagnostics after repeated supervised falls. Root operated captures; this report author only analyzed immutable local outputs. No gain, policy, calibration setting or production driver change is made by this report.
headline_findings: Wrong-address passive attempts are diagnostic errors, not evidence that the sensor lost power or stopped reporting. The corrected reader uses the exact deployed 0x4B address.

After a reboot and sensor-only reset, a 300s no-reset stream had no read/parser failures. Whole yaw +57.64 degrees includes one brief +58.55 degree event; operator could not confirm whether the body moved then. It is neither proven physical motion nor proven stationary drift.

Manual body rotations showed corresponding pitch/roll/yaw signs and strong quaternion/gyro consistency. This argues against a gross frame sign/axis swap, but does not establish physical attitude accuracy or cure the earlier faults.
Quiet intervals after reset and after manual rotations do not validate behavior under motor load. Existing fall/bias evidence remains unresolved.

exact_driver_identity.limits: Algebra/source-equivalent synthetic check, not actual tf2 binary execution or an independently surveyed physical mounting.

passive_reader_erratum.failed_attempts: Two prior passive captures returned only failed reads/errno121 at the wrong address. Preserve both and retract the earlier sensor-shares-motor-power inference. O_RDONLY was not shown to be defective.
passive_reader_erratum.scope: Corrected reader opens I2C O_RDONLY, selects 0x4B and reads; no sensor write/reset/configuration/calibration/ROS/SPI/motor functions.
passive_reader_erratum.verification: 11 offline syscall/fixture/header-identity checks; independent source peer confirmed exact address and30→300s bound-only change.
passive_reader_erratum.timing_limit: 25ms user-space packet retry budget cannot bound a blocked kernel read; root used an external timeout.
passive_reader_erratum.source_history: Initial GCC-Werror misleading-indentation rejection occurred before any binary/capture; corrected with braces without disabling warnings.

boot_boundaries.causal_limit: The user switched robot power and an independent Pi reboot was later observed. Wrong-address reads did not measure the BNO power rail. Successful BNO reset definitely changed sensor state; the original bad state was not retained for a causal reset comparison.
boot_boundaries.new_boot_initial_capture: Correct-address capture before report configuration saw startup/control packets but no enabled measurement stream; not a sensor-health assessment.

reset_semantics: Existing BNO constructor soft reset, product query, RV 0x05+calibrated gyro 0x02 at 100Hz. No explicit calibration enable/disable/tare/save command. Soft reset may persist RAM DCD; not a promise of no flash side effects.

new_boot_no_reset_300s.sequence_advances: Every within-capture gyro and RV report sequence advanced exactly1 modulo256.
new_boot_no_reset_300s.event_operator_observation: Root asked whether body moved; user answered I am not sure. Event remains ambiguous.
new_boot_no_reset_300s.interpretation: Do not discard the event or call the whole change slow stationary drift. Before/after windows are post-hoc descriptions, not a passing replacement acceptance test.

new_boot_manual_body_axes.operator_response: I did the 3 tilts to the best of my abilities.
new_boot_manual_body_axes.completion: Root SIGINT ended the reader after 97.35s; state finalized, exit 130 expected from operator-ended capture, not a full 300s run.
new_boot_manual_body_axes.scope: Waveform-selected negative pitch, positive roll and positive yaw excursions are consistent with requested directions. A large initial yaw repositioning and mixed-axis components prevent a pure-axis calibration claim. Shared BNO channels are not independent ground truth.

analysis_archive.contains: Exact analysis scripts, source/header and wrong-address originals, fake checks/peers, frame algebra, fall-bag cross-checks, old/new reset,300s event/thermal, body-axis arrays and plot. Raw captures remain in separate archives.

review_scope.frame: 105 source-equivalent synthetic rotation checks; independent dynamic waveform agreement is reported separately.
review_scope.oldboot_reset: 92 independent checks and separate exact transport replay.
review_scope.manual_body_axes: 286 independent checks across 25 windows and 9 short-rate sensitivities.
review_scope.newboot_reset: Owner fullsample analysis; no separate independent numerical rerun claimed.
review_scope.event_projection: Owner post-hoc fixed-window integration; whole and30s-bin yaw independently checked.

analysis_revision_note: Event gyro projection now linearly interpolates mapped roll/pitch at gyro receipt times; the earlier nearest-following calculation is preserved. Event integral changes 58.475172→58.475688degrees, with no conclusion change.
limits_and_next_evidence: No physical heading truth from gyro/quaternion agreement; both come from one BNO fusion stack. Report status 0 quaternion and 2/3 gyro are preserved, not interpreted as a health guarantee.
Host report receipts and gaps are not sensor exposure time or physical measurement age; startup backlog and grouped reports can share timestamps.
The body-axis capture has startup-only sequence gaps below .05s. These are retained; subsequent sequences are consecutive.
Published acceleration in earlier ROS bags was unavailable/zero, not measured zero acceleration.
Startup stationary readiness can pass and bias may later develop; no claim that a quiet reset fixes the recurrent falls.

Next useful evidence is synchronized independent view of the body and same-stream IMU with motors inactive, followed by controlled load comparison only if justified; avoid speculative gains, frame offsets, calibration toggles or policy promotion.
